entities.summary: Fifth Republic, a political institution in South Korea during Democratization Movement (1980–1987). Grew from Gwangju Uprising — martial law troops kill hundreds of pro-democracy protesters. Led to the emergence of Gwangju Uprising and Fifth Republic and June Democracy Movement forces democratic concessions.
